deviation: The draft lets the Supplier replace any personnel at any time without notice or consent, removing Arcadia's approval right over named key personnel and the commitment to a replacement of equivalent skill within 15 days. This is worse than even the fallback (15 days' notice with handover), and it risks loss of project continuity and expertise.
suggested_text: The Supplier shall assign the key personnel named in this SOW and shall not replace them without the Customer's prior written consent, and shall provide a replacement of equivalent skill within 15 days of any departure.
